final_interpretation.headline: Phase III.2 produced exploratory leads with ε saturation warning.
scientific_read: Positive conditional lift rows were detected: 6. Primary positive rows: 1.
No strong candidate rows satisfied lift, epsilon, subject-consistency and BIC criteria simultaneously.
Negative controls collapsed under the leakage-safe criteria.
F7 failed: subject-level consistency was insufficient for a strong claim.
F8 failed: the augmented conditional model was not favored by BIC.
F12 warning: ε saturation remains present and must be treated as a diagnostic limitation.
Not evaluated in this standalone diagnostic run: ['F1', 'F5'].
final_interpretation.recommendation: Treat Phase III.2 as an exploratory lead only. Controls passed, but F7/F8 failed and F12 raised an ε saturation warning. Do not claim EEG-RNG coupling. The appropriate next step is to document the lead, preserve the null/guardrail interpretation, and only activate III.2D/III.2E as exploratory extensions or future protocol work.
